 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. PSG have lost another winger to injury, according to reports from the French press today with Zinedine Zidane's squad now out. 
 If you enjoy PSG Talk coverage and want to see more of it, add us as a preferred source on Google to make us a favourite and see more of our content. 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement PSG injury issues are still minor compared to many teams, but there's word today of a new issue which will put them in a worse position going forward.
 The France squad was announced today, and among the fairly long list of absentees was Maghnes Akliouche. The 24 year old is injured and will miss tomorrow's PSG game against Troyes as well as France's team training camp over the next fortnight.
 PSG winger receives double calf knock to rule him out
 Maghnes Akliouche scores his first PSG goal. (Photo by Shaun Botterill/Getty Images)
 RMC Sport report that the attacker "suffered two heavy blows to the same calf", which has created the issue.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement It's bad timing for the summer signing from Monaco. He was just beginning to find some momentum, taking advantage of the season ending injury to Khvicha Kvaratskhelia and starting the last three games in a row.
 He shone against Villarreal on Tuesday and grabbed two assists in the convincing win.
 The good news is that this sounds like a pretty minor issue in the grand scheme of things, and Akliouche should be back after the break fit and fully refreshed for the next stage of the season.
 In other news…
 David Boly's debut and goal was a really special moment for him and PSG supporters who love to see academy players shine. 
 Ibrahim Maza is a name we're hearing linked with PSG more and more often at the moment, and this week he spoke out about the links.
